name: com.stackscan/mcp-server
description: Look up the technology stack behind any domain, and the company running it.

environmentVariables.name: STACKSCAN_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token from the StackScan dashboard, My Account -> API Tokens.

environmentVariables.name: STACKSCAN_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Workspace UUID, shown on the same page as the token.

environmentVariables.name: STACKSCAN_SESSION_LOOKUP_CAP
environmentVariables.description: Maximum credit-consuming lookups per session. Defaults to 25.
